wiki.title: Cal Musselman
wiki.extract: Calvin R. "Cal" Musselman is an American politician and real estate broker serving as a member of the Utah Senate from the 4th district. He previously served as a member of the Utah House of Representatives from the 9th district. Elected in 2018, he assumed office on January 1, 2019.
